'''Stew''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Gunnery Sergeant]] who was present on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] when [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] disguised as a cadet named "Lucky" blew up a large part of the ship. He wore [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunner]] armor with personalized paint on his helmet. He helped the [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] of the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] with target practice, and when asked what he used as targets, he replied "malfunctioning droids" to the great distress of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
